entries.old_statement: 12 of 39 errata touch a named misconception; M5 matched 2, M6 matched 6
entries.corrected_statement: Keyword matching, hand-checked. M5 ('an unsigned sqrt(V) is diffusion, not impact') matched ERR-HU-010 and ERR-HU-035 on the word 'diffus', but this lane measured the SIGNED response throughout, so no such error was made -- those hits are spurious. M6 ('the square-root law is insensitive to tick size') matched six errata on the bare word 'tick', none of which is about that claim -- also spurious. The verified count is FOUR misconceptions (M1-M4) instantiated by TWO errata (ERR-HU-012 and ERR-HU-013), not twelve errata across six. The headline is unaffected and is about kind, not count: a section titled 'Common Misconceptions' enumerated in advance an error this lane then discovered by measurement.
